- Added a select between action to the chat selection bar, so you can now select every message between two selected messages at once, up to 100 messages
- Improved the chat selection bar, which now shows the selected message count and uses icon buttons that no longer get truncated
- Added tooltips to the chat top bar icons, so you can now hover over a button to see what it does

---

- 新增了聊天选择栏的区间全选操作，现在选中两条消息后可以一次选中它们之间的全部消息，最多 100 条
- 对聊天选择栏进行了改善，这使得选择栏会显示已选消息数量，各项操作改用图标按钮，不再被截断
- 新增了聊天顶栏图标的提示，现在鼠标悬停在按钮上即可查看它的作用
